data.one_liner: Naver Map plugin for Flutter providing map services for South Korea.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Naver Map services into Flutter applications on Android and iOS. Allows displaying maps, adding markers, managing camera positions, and handling custom overlays.
use_when: You need detailed map services and location features specifically for South Korea.
Your application requires Naver Map integration.
avoid_when: You need global map coverage utilizing standard providers like Google Maps instead of Naver.
You want a pure Dart map solution without native platform SDK dependencies.
strengths: Provides official Naver Map integration for Flutter.
Supports custom overlays, markers, and camera position streaming.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup and client ID configuration through the Naver Cloud Platform console.
Dependent on native Naver Map SDK versions and platform-specific minimum SDK requirements.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering an application on the Naver Cloud Platform console, setting a Client ID, updating minimum Android SDK to 6.0 (SDK 23) and iOS to 12.0, and executing an initialization function before runApp.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you require global map support powered by Google Maps instead of Naver Map.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a pure Dart map widget using OpenStreetMap tiles without native SDK setup.
